KNOW YOUR MOVES

Less mashing. More smashing.

PLAYER 1 / KEYBOARD

W A S D Move in the depth lanes

J / X Attack · hold for a combo

K / Space Jump · attack in air to kick

Shift / O Dash / shoulder charge

L / C Special · costs 8 health

I / E Grab / screen throw

Esc / P Pause · M Mute · F Fullscreen

GAMEPAD / TOUCH / CO-OP

Stick / D-pad: move. X: attack. A: jump.

B: dash. Y: special. RB: grab / throw.

Start: pause / resume. Second gamepad controls P2.

Touch: drag anywhere on the left side to move; use the five action buttons on the right.

P2 keyboard: arrows move; , attack, . jump, / special, ; grab, ' dash.

Numpad 1 / 2 / 3 / 0 / 4 also controls P2.

THE SIGNATURE THROW: Hit a Foot to stun them, step close, then press GRAB. Press GRAB again to fling them at the screen, or ATTACK for a crowd-clearing body slam. Throws are deliberate, not random.

Attacks face left or right: align your feet with your target's lane. Orange Foot guard frontal strikes—break their guard with a finisher, dash, special, or grab. Cones become projectiles; red drums explode. Pizza fully restores health. Jump the wrecking ball, leave Krang's marked target, and punish Baxter when he lands.
